explication: GPUI Kit is a Rust desktop UI framework. The principal workflow is: an application starts through the kit, composes styled components or its own design system, reuses base interaction/state infrastructure, and renders through GPUI to a native surface. Major stages include component presentation, editing and data interaction, layout and motion, and optional JavaScript extension hosting. The graph emphasizes documented layering and sampled subsystems; several feature links remain intentionally broad because their implementation was not sampled.
